Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
This card is the "Hold" that's a reaction, and deals with Action
Modifiers.

Two questions about it:
1) Can you choose any action modifier in the ash heap at all, even if no
action modifiers have been played during this current action?
1a) Even if they are dual-type cards? (i.e. Swallowed by the Night)

2) Is Form of Mist considered an Action Modifier or isn't it, these days?
There isnt a <*> symbol on it, and the new wording seems to indicate "not",
but it will matter for this card.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> This card is the "Hold" that's a reaction, and deals with Action
> Modifiers.
>
> Two questions about it:
> 1) Can you choose any action modifier in the ash heap at all, even if no
> action modifiers have been played during this current action?

Yes.

> 1a) Even if they are dual-type cards? (i.e. Swallowed by the Night)

Yes.

> 2) Is Form of Mist considered an Action Modifier or isn't it, these days?

Not when EMH is legal for play.
That's the previous errata. It will be undone by the new card text in Anarchs
when Anarchs becomes legal.
